title: Day Tour to Banff Gondola Johnston Canyon Hiking Hot Springs
includes: Choose ONE - either Banff Gondola or Hot Springs (extra cost)
In winter, icewalk crampons will be provided and use at your own responsibility
Pickup from Calgary, Canmore or Banff designated points
Suggested guide tips ($12 cash per person) (not included)
Meals and drinks, personal expenses, travel insurance (not included)
Gondola or Hot Springs. We will contact you closer to the departure date to purchase (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Indulge in a day of exploration in Banff National Park. Ascend Sulphur Mountain aboard the Banff Gondola for panoramic views or unwind in the natural hot springs. 
Enjoy a leisurely shopping spree and lunch in the charming Banff town. Finally, venture into the renowned Johnston Canyon for an invigorating hike amidst nature's wonders.
